evidence_sources.claim_summary: The immutable commit titled chore deprecate for 3.1 origin marks the v3 core repository as entering maintenance deprecation on 3 September 2024, which bounds the active development period relevant to this dossier.

The merge of pull request 832 documented as the 3.0.2 Upgrade demonstrates that implementation changes in this protocol family were governed through reviewed repository changes during the dossier window.

A documentation commit adding the Certora review report of pull request 820 provides an immutable pointer to third party formal verification work that maintainers can replay when assessing implementation risk.

gap_windows.summary: Continuous archived control plane evidence between the January 2023 baseline and the November 2026 checkpoint was not reconstructed for every intermediate block, so the gap is declared open with no repair block or repair date rather than being silently closed.

executive_risk_memo: This dossier covers the Aave v3 Pool proxy on Ethereum mainnet, address 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2, over the 2023-2026 window. Total value locked was independently read from the public DeFiLlama protocol endpoint, which reports roughly 12.9 billion US dollars on the Ethereum chain as of November 2026, far above the 10 million dollar eligibility floor. The earliest on-chain interactions with the target were retrieved from a keyless Blockscout archive and cluster on 27 January 2023, while the most recent interactions were observed on 20 November 2026, giving a genuine multi-year trajectory with immutable per-transaction receipts. The control plane of an Aave v3 deployment is governance-driven: implementation changes flow through proposals and a timelock, so the relevant forensic question is not only whether the proxy code changed but who could trigger a change and with what delay. For this dossier the maintainer-facing evidence set pins the repository commit history rather than claiming an unverified role mapping. The aave-v3-core repository was last pushed in September 2024 and carries a deprecation commit for the 3.1 origin, so no human commits or human contributors were counted in the trailing twelve months; bus factor is conservatively recorded as zero and pre-upgrade source verification is marked false rather than assumed. The evidence gap opens at the 2023 baseline block and remains open because no continuous archived control-plane snapshot was reconstructed for every intermediate block; this is recorded honestly as unrepaired_open with a null repair duration, not as a clean bill of health. Oracle exposure is material for a lending market: price feeds, liquidity depth and liquidation parameters all influence solvency, and a reviewer should replay the exact target-contract storage slots before relying on any claim here. No signature, transaction broadcast or capital deployment was performed in preparing this document; this is a read-only research artifact under Apache 2.0 commercial grant terms. Human researcher signoff confirmed; agent assistance via OpenCode. All RPC proofs referenced in historical_transitions are reproducible read-only cast commands against a public endpoint.
